title: Sheket blocklist, schema 1
description: GET /v1/blocklist.json. Spec section 6.1. A document that fails this schema is rejected whole and the previous list is kept.

version.description: Generation time in Unix seconds. Only increases; a client ignores a list whose version is not greater than the one it holds.

call_prefixes.description: E.164 prefixes. Android blocks any caller starting with one; iOS expands a prefix only when it leaves at most 4 free digits.

sms_senders.description: SMS senders whose messages go to Junk: E.164 numbers or sender IDs, compared case-insensitively.

sms_keywords.description: Substring keywords matched after normalisation (NFKC, Hebrew niqqud removed, lowercased).

sms_allow_senders.description: SMS senders that are always allowed. Evaluated before every other SMS rule.
